sql: select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) series, count(*) n, sum(case when status in ('filled','partial') and client_order_id not like 'limmexit%' then 1 else 0 end) fills, sum(case when status='rejected' then 1 else 0 end) rej from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' group by 1 order by n desc limit 20
